title: Scam & Unauthorized Charges
body: I cancelled my subscription before renewal, but Fabulous charged me anyway – two years in a row! When I asked for a refund, they pretended they “cannot locate the transaction” even though I sent them proof. They take your money, cancel your subscription, and then refuse to give it back. This is a scam. Be very careful – this app causes more harm than help.
